description: This source file implements cryptographic hash functions including MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512, with functions for processing, padding, and finalizing hashes. It also includes external dependencies on system headers for network byte order conversions and defines internal macros and classes for hash computation.
